name: knowledgebot-ai
description: KnowledgeBot AI monorepo root. Declares ZERO dependencies and ZERO devDependencies on purpose: .npmrc sets shared-workspace-lockfile=false, so a single root dependency would write a FIFTH pnpm-lock.yaml and break the four-lockfile contract that security-scanning-toolchain scans. Every root config here is therefore zero-install. engines.node is DERIVED, not chosen: .npmrc sets engine-strict=true, so the floor must satisfy every engines.node declared anywhere in the installed tree or `pnpm install` dies with ERR_PNPM_UNSUPPORTED_ENGINE on a version this file says is supported. 22.20.0 is the lowest Node 22.x satisfying all 872 of them; the two that bind are size-limit@13.0.3 (^22.18.0, a required devDependency of apps/widget) and rollup's linux-x64-only optional @napi-rs/lzma-linux-x64-gnu@1.5.1 (^22.20). Re-derive this number on any dependency bump; never round it down to match .nvmrc.
